Name: Alex Mustacular (Bodybuilder Muscle Alex) (CP)
Author: Molenfeuer
Description:
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Download the newest version of this mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/96969738?tab=user+files]NexusMods[/url] or the GitHub [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/AlexMustacular/releases]release page[/url]﻿
[*]Extract the ZIP-File and put the folder into the mods folder of SMAPI (mostly located under "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods")
[/list][size=5][b]
Options & Compatibility[/b][/size]
Available configuration:
[list]
[*]Seasonal Outfits: Change Alex's outfit by season (Style copied from Seasonal Outfits by Poltergeister)
[*]Extra Festival Outfits: Include additional festival outfits i.e. for Spirit's Eve
[/list]Available languages: 🇬🇧 🇩🇪 🇵🇹 🇫🇷
Compatible with: ✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][b][size=5]

Features[/size][/b][list]
[*]Watch how a very muscular and buffed Alex lives
[*]Experience the old (and better) hair sprite of Alex
[/list][b][size=5]
Contribute[/size][/b]
If something doesn't work, or you miss a feature, feel free to open a new issue on the [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/AlexMustacular/issues]GitHub Page of this mod[/url]. I prefer the GitHub Page but if you really don't want to use it feel free to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9565?tab=bugs]Issue Page here on NexusMods[/url].[b]
[size=5]
